rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; CoRR database comprises 9 sub-datasets from different institutions (BNU3, HNU1, IPCAS1, IPCAS3, IPCAS4, MRN1, NYU2, Utah1, Utah2) plus UCLA dataset; multiple scanners (Siemens TrioTim, GE Discovery MR750, Siemens Allegra)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The brain rs-fMRI images used in this project were obtained from three public neuroimaging databases. The Consortium for Reliability and Reproducibility (CoRR) public database (36) was chosen because it contains a large number of different datasets with data from healthy subjects" ; Table 1 lists 9 CoRR sub-datasets and UCLA with different manufacturers (Siemens, GE) and models (TrioTim, Discovery MR750, Allegra)
rci1_using_msad.location: OliveiraSaraiva2023.pdf.md: Methods / 2.1. Data description, L81; Table 1, L93-L107

rci2_using_epd.detail: Training reference cohort (H-Train) uses CoRR and UCLA datasets; neither appears in the 18 EPD list. COBRE is in the EPD list but was used only for independent testing (H-Test-C, SCZ-Test-C), not for NM training.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "H-Train represents the 366 healthy subjects from CORR and UCLA datasets that were used to train the model." ; "The Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) public dataset (38–41)...was also chosen to evaluate the performance of the trained model on an independent dataset."
rci2_using_epd.location: OliveiraSaraiva2023.pdf.md: Methods / Table 2, L155; Methods / 2.1. Data description, L81

rci3_epd_name.detail: RCI-2 = No; training reference data consists of CoRR and UCLA, which are not in the EPD list
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "H-Train represents the 366 healthy subjects from CORR and UCLA datasets that were used to train the model."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC (H-Train); pooled from CoRR (9 sub-datasets) and UCLA healthy subjects
rci5_n.supporting_text: "H-Train represents the 366 healthy subjects from CORR and UCLA datasets that were used to train the model." ; "After training the autoencoder with 366 healthy subjects, it was tested with both healthy subjects and patients."
rci5_n.location: OliveiraSaraiva2023.pdf.md: Methods / Table 2, L155; Methods / 2.4.3, L175

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; Table 2 reports 47% females for H-Train (N=366). female_n and male_n estimated from percentage: 366 × 0.47 ≈ 172 females, 366 − 172 = 194 males

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; mean age and range from Table 2 (H-Train row); SD not reported; age in years
